$comment: The opening objective chain, GAME_DESIGN.md section 3 ("the first fifteen minutes"). Steps are ordered and checked in order, so completing step 3 early cannot skip step 2. Objectives.ts contains no literals.
$comment_predicate: predicate.kind is one of flag, partySize, itemCount. See Objectives.ts for what each one reads.
$comment_marker: marker is optional. When present it adds a compass pin for the step, in the same shape HUD.CompassMarker expects, kind 'objective'.
